Exact HMLR and height-difference values are checked.
Candidate confidence must be at least 96.
Support outputs retain fake_data=false and final_ready=false.

Extractor compares float(point evidence coordinates) to finite canonical coordinates without first requiring finiteness; abs(NaN - value) > tolerance is false.
Point and HMLR evidence rows are read without binding slot_id, expected status, final_ready=false and fake_data=false.
Current task pins point and HMLR evidence blobs, but the extractor does not compare either input file to those expected blob SHAs.
Seed area is only converted through a finite-number helper; zero, negative or implausibly large areas are not rejected.
HMLR preparation converts seed longitude/latitude directly to floats and the post-transform range check does not explicitly reject NaN/Infinity.
The requested HMLR URL must be HTTPS and the final host is allowlisted, but the final redirect scheme is not revalidated.
Preparation loads an existing hmlr_exact_matches.json after a zero matcher exit without deleting it first or requiring a current run token.
Matcher output omits starter-manifest SHA/generation and candidate top-level identity; downstream cannot prove which input produced the matches.
Matcher requires only three candidate objects; it does not independently require exact target rows or distinct parcel and HMLR identities.
Matcher limits file count but not total feature count, vertex count, geometry size or output size; WKT and GeoJSON duplicate full geometries.
Matcher writes directly to the final path and default json.dumps permits NaN tokens.
Capabilities and DescribeCoverage use stream=False and response.content is fully buffered before the MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES check.
Sampler reads data[0] without requiring exactly one numeric elevation band or validating dtype/range metadata.
Sampler records resolution but does not require zero rotation/shear, north-up orientation, finite transform or positive exact pixel dimensions.
EA sampler writes directly to its final JSON path with default allow_nan behavior.
Web candidate binding verifies row, HMLR ID, metric and confidence but never verifies parcel_id.
Served operation rows are checked for number continuity and fake_data=true only; slot/task/attempt/continuation/final_ready are not enforced.
Any contiguous unique operation-number range of the declared length passes; the expected first and last operation numbers are not pinned.
Web verifier writes the final acceptance receipt directly with json.dump.
